# The page of the first section changes after the claims were read: the abstract step of the fake agent edits it. The person approves the draft,
# but the staleness check reads the cited pages again, finds that the quote left its page, and stops the item before the publish.
[!exec:jq] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

rdinit
rdfakes
env HOME=$WORK/home
env RESEARCH_DESK_DIR=$WORK/rd
env RESEARCH_HOME=$WORK/store
env SEARCH_API=http://search.test
env WIKI_API=http://wiki.test
env RESEARCH_HEADER_FILE=$WORK/home/.research/credential.header

exec obeereal item add research-desk cold-cost --title 'Cold and cost' --body-file body.txt
! exec obeereal run cold-cost research-desk --workflow rd/workflow.star &

waitstatus 'paused: Review the draft report of cold-cost, round 1'
exec obeereal answer cold-cost approve
wait
stderr 'a quote left its page, so nothing is published'
stderr 'STALE: the quote of c1 left http://pages.test/page/a'

# The quote of the second section is still on its page, so only one quote is stale. Nothing was written to the wiki.
! stderr 'STALE: the quote of c4'
! exists wiki.log

-- body.txt --
How does the cold change the output of a unit, and what does it cost?
-- drift --
-- home/.research/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
-- resp/_search --
{"results":[{"url":"http://pages.test/page/a"},{"url":"http://pages.test/page/b"}]}
-- resp/_page_a --
<p>Winter tests. At -20 C the output fell by 30 percent.</p>
-- resp/_page_b --
<p>The unit costs 12 euro per month.</p>
